clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman Stonebrow watches troggs wreck Gol'Bolar Quarry and calls for help. They have broken his equipment and powder barrels, and his fading aim keeps him from fighting them himself. He sends willing fighters into the pit to thin the Rockjaw Skullthumpers.

Troggs have overrun the lower terraces of Gol'Bolar Quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. The dwarven excavation once produced well, until the creatures broke through the bedrock and flooded its tunnels. Now they smash the scaffolding and blast apart barrels of powder, leaving the quarry in ruin.

Foreman Stonebrow watches the ruin from the ridge, furious at what has become of his life's work. Age has weakened his hands and spoiled his aim, so he calls on passing wanderers and Alliance recruits to fight in his place. He wants the burly Rockjaw Skullthumpers thinned, though only their complete destruction would satisfy his anger.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!
Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!
This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!
I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It makes me so mad! Grrr...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, that makes me feel a little better...
But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
